reason: The text describes the rebuilding of Jerusalem's wall and depicts Nehemiah organizing people of all social classes (nobles, officials, and common people) to work together in unified defense. While enemies mock the Jews as 'weak ones' (הָאֲמֵלָלִים), this derision is presented as a false assessment to overcome, not as truth. The organizational structure shows nobles and officials working alongside common laborers, with shared weapons and equal participation in both construction and defense (חַרְבֹתֵיהֶם רָמְחֵיהֶם וְקַשְּׁתֹתֵיהֶם). Nehemiah's leadership emphasizes collective courage and divine protection for all classes equally. The text celebrates unified action across social strata rather than any inherent superiority of the elite.
